svg.text: Magpie Gateway — AWS Sovereign Solution Architecture
Australian Sovereign AI & MCP Governance • Amazon EKS Auto Mode (ap-southeast-2) • Amazon Bedrock AU Profiles • Microsoft Entra ID & Sentinel
• Zero-trust: agents hold virtual keys only
• AU DLP: TFN, ABN, Medicare, BSB, Keys
AWS Cloud — Australian Sovereign Region (ap-southeast-2 Sydney / ap-southeast-4 Melbourne)
Terraform-managed reference deployment (deploy/terraform/aws) • IRAP-assessed AWS services
Strict Security Groups • Zero public pod IPs • Private ingress via CloudFront VPC Origin
Private Subnets (2 AZs • internal-elb + EKS Auto Mode)
All compute, audit storage, and internal proxy traffic remain private

g.text: /guardrails/* & /mcp/check → HTTP 404 Denied at Edge (SG: CloudFront prefix list)

svg.text: Amazon EKS Auto Mode Cluster (magpie namespace)
Co-located Pod • Read-only root FS • Non-root UID 65532 • cap_drop ALL
Optional Sidecar: Microsoft Presidio PII Analyzer / Anonymizer (:5002 / :5001) for enhanced NER

g.text: Allow-listed per tool via CEL policy
JSON bundles for ISM / PSPF / IRAP
